name: Ed Rooth
bio: Ed Rooth (aka Hekuli) is a solo developer and visual artist with over 20 years in software. He's the creator of Chromatose, a real-time, shader-based video synthesizer for iOS that he designs, engineers, and ships entirely on his own. A longtime DJ and electronic-music hobbyist, he fell down the real-time-graphics rabbit hole, taught himself Metal, and set out to put a GPU instrument in everyone's pocket.
